{{Quote|The only arrival code we've received is for Imperial Starship 2423T6H3L5. Pilot Lieutenant Commander Ina'irolia'kleoni, of the Chiss alliance.|Lieutenant [[Palinx]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Imperial Starship 2423T6H3L5''' was the official designation of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloted]] by [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ina'irolia'kleoni]], its transponder codes were stolen by [[Combo]] and used by a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] to board the Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']].<ref name="SWTOR" />
